description: This file defines the 'wsdl' class, a PHP class used for parsing, representing, and serializing WSDL (Web Services Description Language) documents. It contains methods for loading WSDL from URLs or files, handling XML parsing events, retrieving operation and type information, and generating WSDL descriptions. The class extends 'nusoap_base' and is part of a web service toolkit, specifically for SOAP-based web service interactions.

classes.name: wsdl
classes.description: A comprehensive PHP class for parsing WSDL documents, accessing their data, and generating WSDL XML.

methods.name: wsdl
methods.description: Constructor: initializes the wsdl object, optionally loads and parses WSDL from given URL or file.

methods.name: parseWSDL
methods.description: Loads and parses a WSDL document from URL or file into internal data structures.

methods.name: start_element
methods.description: Handles XML start tags during WSDL parsing, updating internal schema and service details.

methods.name: end_element
methods.description: Handles XML end tags during WSDL parsing, finalizing schemas and structures.

methods.name: character_data
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements during parsing.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns a list of operations for the WSDL, filtered by binding type.

methods.name: getOperationData
methods.description: Retrieves input and output data for a specified operation.

methods.name: getOperationDataForSoapAction
methods.description: Finds operation data based on SOAPAction header value.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire WSDL object into XML format for deployment or inspection.

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Adds a new complex type schema definition to the WSDL.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a new simple type schema definition to the WSDL.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element definition to the WSDL types.

methods.name: webDescription
methods.description: Outputs an HTML page describing the WSDL's services and operations.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a simple type to the WSDL schema, resolving namespace prefixes and extending the schema with new simple types.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an element to the WSDL types, using the appropriate namespace.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Registers an operation with the service, configuring input/output message structures, bindings, and SOAP specifics.
